description: This file implements a retry utility with configurable options, including exponential backoff, jitter, and custom retry conditions. It exports types, constants, and an async retry function.

methods.name: resolveRetryConfig
methods.description: Resolves and clamps retry configuration parameters with defaults and overrides.

methods.name: applyJitter
methods.description: Applies jitter to a delay based on a secure random fraction.

methods.name: retryAsync
methods.description: Retries an asynchronous function with exponential backoff, jitter, and optional custom retry logic.
